description: Compute the pairwise correlation matrix for a set of assets. Identifies highly correlated pairs and diversification opportunities.

lookback_days.description: Historical window for computing correlations in trading days. 30 = ~6 weeks, 252 = ~1 year. Range: 30-1260. Default: 252.

method.description: Correlation method. "pearson" = linear correlation (standard), "spearman" = rank-based (robust to outliers), "kendall" = concordance-based. Default: "pearson".

tickers.description: Tickers to include in the correlation matrix. Minimum 2, maximum 50. Free tier: max 10 tickers. Paid tier: up to 50.

name: correlation_matrix
